integrity.claim_scope: complete fixed-scale phase classification and unique asymptotically optimal Gaussian scale
integrity.proof_state: analytic proof with reproducible computational checks

limitations: Fixed centered Gaussian proposal variance independent of the number of strata; one observation independently sampled in each equal-probability stratum.
Only the quadratic observable under the standard Gaussian target; general integrands, unequal strata, other proposal families and adaptive choices are not covered.
This is an analytic benchmark whose target moment is already known; no finite-sample optimality among all methods is claimed.
The exact coefficients and asymptotics have been proof-checked and computationally cross-checked, but not independently audited; specialist publication precedence may remain.
title: Sharp Gaussian importance scales for independently stratified quadratic integration
